posts.title: The AI War Is Already at Your Front Door
posts.description: AI is accelerating hacking and ransomware while helping defenders secure websites and computers. Here is why everyday security deserves your attention now.

posts.title: Dolly Parton and the Courage to Become Yourself
posts.description: Dolly Parton’s life reminds us to know ourselves, protect what we create, remain connected to our roots, and turn success into something useful for others.

posts.title: I Started a Book Club. Kinda.
posts.description: I started a local book club in my area by passing books to a friend and letting useful ideas travel from one reader to the next.
